experiment: N3COND B3: in-cap shrink-only gain normalization, read-dev seeds, after the C1 failure

seeds.not: These seeds already trained and scored C0/C1. They are not a fresh holdout. No result in this file may be called unbiased or out-of-sample.

hypothesis.one_sentence: Per start, inside Q, shrink coordinates steeper than the median by at most 2x, never inflate the flat ones, and set the scalar gain from the shrunk magnitudes.
hypothesis.why_this_one: C1 inflated s3 (near-zero shell slope) up to 4x and shrank steep coordinates down to 0.25, then froze the gain outside Q. Energy got worse. This hypothesis removes the inflation and the outside-cap freeze. It only shrinks, and the shrink stops at 1/2. The floor is not scanned.
hypothesis.selection_cost: The choice uses the already-reported C0/C1 ledger (428160 energy queries). That cost is exploratory selection, not part of B3's Q, and B3 does not pretend to be the first look.

arms.M0: Matched scalar control. Same axial calibration queries as M2, charged inside Q. lambda_j = 1. The scalar gain uses the median axial |g|. This is not historical C0, which used 8 simultaneous probes.
arms.M2: Shrink. lambda_j = clip(median(g)/g_j, 0.5, 1). sigma_j = sigma0_j * lambda_j. The scalar gain uses median(lambda*g) and the same Spall target 0.5. Gain is recomputed at every start. Nothing is frozen from another seed.

allocation.Q: q*L, and every energy query the optimizer uses is inside it. outside_cap_queries = 0.
allocation.per_start: 2*nparam axial calibration queries (one two-sided probe per coordinate) + 2K perturbations + 2 candidates
allocation.why_K_differs_by_circuit: One axial probe per coordinate. Nov3 has more coordinates, so it spends more of the same Q on calibration. The M2-vs-M0 contrast is within a circuit, where K matches. Nov3-vs-QAOA is reported with that K difference visible.
allocation.init: same TQA embedding and U(-0.6,0.6) starts as B1, keyed by circuit id so M0 and M2 share starts and the perturb stream
allocation.diag_recompute: one uncharged state rebuild after energy selection, for F, parity, and norm only

ansatz: Original Nov3 unchanged: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, full s1/s2/s3. QAOA p=L. B* instances already accepted. No new classical search.
selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. Fidelity is not a target, a stop, or a gate.

gate.cell: N9 L3 q=1024 Nov3, all 8 read-dev seeds
gate.statistic: paired Delta E = E(M2) - E(M0). Negative means M2 is lower.
gate.pass: median Delta E < 0 and the bootstrap 95% CI of the mean lies entirely below 0
gate.fail: anything else, including a fidelity gain with an energy CI that includes 0
gate.on_pass: Still read-dev. Do not call it a holdout win. Do not adopt. Do not start N15.
gate.on_fail: Negative. Do not scan another floor in this batch.
